board_name: Central Board of Secondary Education (NCERT Ganita Prakash)

topics.title: Playing with Numbers: Factors & Multiples
topics.description: Discover factors, multiples, prime and composite numbers, divisibility tests, and calculate HCF and LCM.
topics.standard_title: Chapter 3: Playing with Numbers (Factors, Multiples, Prime Factorisation, HCF, LCM)

easy.description: Identifying factors, multiples, and prime numbers under 30

medium.description: Prime factorisation with factor trees and HCF (GCD) of two numbers

hard.description: LCM and HCF word problems and coprime number identification

topics.title: Fractions: Concepts & Operations
topics.description: Understand proper, improper, and mixed fractions, equivalent fractions, and like/unlike addition and subtraction.

medium.description: Unlike-denominator addition and subtraction using LCM of denominators

hard.description: Mixed numbers addition and subtraction in real-life contexts

topics.title: Decimals: Tenths, Hundredths & Measurement
topics.description: Represent tenths and hundredths on number lines, convert between fractions and decimals, and perform operations in money and lengths.

easy.description: Tenths place conversions and simple addition

medium.description: Hundredths place operations in rupee-paise and meter-centimeter conversions

hard.description: Decimal subtraction with borrowing and uneven decimal places

topics.title: The Other Side of Zero: Integers
topics.description: Explore positive and negative numbers, represent them on the number line, and perform integer addition and subtraction.
topics.standard_title: Chapter 6: Integers (The Other Side of Zero)

easy.description: Comparing integers and addition of positive and small negative numbers

medium.description: Subtraction of negative numbers and combining opposite signs

topics.title: Ratio, Proportion & Unitary Method
topics.description: Compare quantities by division, determine whether ratios are in proportion, and apply the unitary method to solve practical problems.

easy.description: Simplifying ratios to lowest terms and finding simple equivalent ratios

medium.description: Testing proportionality and unitary method with whole numbers

hard.description: Multi-step unitary method problems involving speed, distance, or cost

topics.title: Mensuration: Perimeter & Area
topics.description: Calculate perimeter of regular and irregular figures, and calculate area of squares, rectangles, and parallelograms.

easy.description: Perimeter of rectangles and squares using formulas

medium.description: Area of rectangles and squares and finding missing side given area

hard.description: Area and perimeter of parallelograms and composite grid figures
